body:
Founder real-time: 'continue working on parena editor' (continuation).

Home/End originally jumped to the start/end of the WHOLE buffer -- correct while single-line-only, wrong real editor UX once multi-line shipped earlier the same day. Fixed move-cursor-home/move-cursor-end directly (not a new function under a different name) via new real line-start-before/line-end-after backward/forward newline scans.

Verified with a real multi-line test: Home/End from different positions across a real 3-line buffer correctly stay within the current line's own real boundaries, not the whole buffer's. The pre-existing single-line tests needed no changes (never actually distinguished the two behaviors). Clean under -Werror and ASan+UBSan, zero regression.

Commit: 3671e07.

⚓ ☃
title: Real, line-aware Home/End -- fixed from whole-buffer to per-line now that multi-line editing is real
